verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly ships API access tokens, an official CLI, and an MCP server, indicating flags, targeting, and other resources can be managed programmatically alongside the UI, but the evidence pack never explicitly claims full UI/API parity and the openapi.json/swagger probes at guessed paths returned 404s, leaving the completeness of API coverage unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit vendor statement of 1:1 API/UI parity, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent/hands-on confirmation that all UI actions (e.g., approvals, experimentation setup, guarded rollouts) are fully scriptable via API.
